body:
Decided with the maintainer on 2026-09-29. Both clients' list-properties page groups its sections in the same cards as Settings/Admin (Android: the T-336 SectionCard; web: section.card with 1rem padding and a 1rem h2), in this order, identical on both clients:
1. Clear checked items (N) — first, it is among the most used (not on ledgers); keeps its danger styling.
2. List: name + Save, type selector (with its help text).
3. Categories: drag order + Save order (not on ledgers).
4. Notes.
5. Shared with: members, pending invites, invite by e-mail (the local area's 'only on this phone' text on Android).
6. Notifications: the per-list switch (Android only).
7. Closing (ledgers only).
8. Actions: Duplicate list.
9. Leave list / Delete list in a card with a danger border and danger title, with the 'can't leave yet' hint.
Today Android has Duplicate before Closing and the web after; this settles it. No behaviour change. Keep all test tags; tests assert the order on both clients (y positions on Android, DOM order on the web) with a mutation each; Android screenshots re-recorded.
title: List properties in cards on both clients, one order: Clear checked first, then List, Categories, Notes, Shared with, Notifications, Closing, Actions, Leave
